messages:
Alex C: Heads-up — saw p95 jumps on /embed/high around 03:06 UTC during the nightly deploy. perf-bot flagged a kernel fallback and microbatch collapse.
perf-bot: [auto] p95=820ms (prev=320ms) at 03:07 route=/embed/high pool=pool-3 kernel=fallback_gemm kv_cache_hit=14% microbatch_size_p50=1
Maria R: Confirming — KV prefix cache hit dropped from ~92% -> ~14% for that route. Lots of misses that forced extra KV prefetch work.
Sam T: Do we have flamegraphs or kernel traces for the spike window?
Alex C: Uploaded a short trace: https://dash.internal/redwood/traces/trace-2356789012. Quick glance: when batcher token budget hit the lower bound we ended up with many size-1 microbatches; kernel selector switched from fast_gemm -> fallback_gemm leading to 5-12ms extra per-token.
Jen L: That matches what I saw in local repro — catastrophic combination: token_budget floor + synchronized queue sampler -> many single-request batches -> kernel penalty + extra prefetch overhead.
Maria R: Proposed mitigations: raise min_token_budget for premium routes (8 -> 12), enable jittered queue sampler to de-correlate arrivals, and delay kernel fallback by a tiny hysteresis window so single stray small batches don't force kernel switch.
Sam T: Quick experiment patch (pseudocode):
```json
{
  "route": "/embed/high",
  "min_token_budget": 12,
  "queue_sampler": "jittered(5ms)",
  "kernel_fallback_hysteresis_ms": 10
}
```
Alex C: Can we run a canary on pool-3 for 2 hours with ~5% of traffic? I'll schedule and watch tail. If p95 drops back under 400ms we can roll to 10%.
perf-bot: Canary started on pool-3 (canary-id=canary-2356789012) — baseline p95=330ms, target p95<=400ms. Logging enabled: kernel_switch_trace, kv_prefetch_latency.
Jen L: Also add a metric for microbatch size distribution (p50/p90/p99) per route so we can detect correlated collapse earlier.
Maria R: Note: we should instrument kernel selection path to emit which kernel was chosen along with kv cache hit boolean. I added an issue: #4127.
Sam T: PR for the queue sampler jitter and min_token_budget change is up: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/4082 — includes test harness to simulate KV pressure.
Alex C: I'll monitor dashboards: https://dash.internal/redwood/d/p95-embed-high. If any tail regresses I'll abort canary immediately.
Jen L: If canary looks good for 2h, plan: rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% over next 24h with automated rollback if p95 > 450ms for 15m.
Maria R: Follow-up action: add KV cache synthetic load test to CI so we don't regress cache-sensitive routes again.
Alex C: Thanks all — ping me in thread if you see unexpected alerts. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: [auto] 03:18 Canary p95 snapshot: 380ms (canary-id=canary-2356789012) microbatch_p50=3 microbatch_p90=8 kernel_mismatch_rate=2% kv_cache_hit=68%
Sam T: Early signs good. I'll leave sampling enabled and collect a 6h profile for kernel hot paths.
Jen L: Reminder: update runbooks to include "check microbatch distribution + kernel_mismatch_rate" when troubleshooting p95.
Alex C: Noted. Closing loop after 6h profile.
